# wp-event-booking

> Event booking core with seat capacity, FIFO waitlists, idempotent requests and atomic conditional updates that never oversell under concurrent bookings, ready for WordPress Composer package `trysac/u952-wp-event-booking`, namespace `Trysac\WpEventBooking`, MIT
> licensed, PHP >= 8.4, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
